questions.question: Nilesh points to a woman and says, "She is the only daughter of my wife's grandfather's only child." How is the woman related to Nilesh?
questions.hindiQuestion: नीलेश एक महिला की ओर इशारा करते हुए कहता है, "वह मेरी पत्नी के दादा के इकलौते बच्चे की इकलौती बेटी है।" वह महिला नीलेश से किस प्रकार संबंधित है?
questions.explanation: Nilesh's wife's grandfather's only child is his wife's father (or mother). The only daughter of his wife's father is Nilesh's wife herself.

questions.question: A says of a photograph, "She is the only daughter of the father of my mother." How is A related to the person in the photograph?
questions.hindiQuestion: A एक तस्वीर की ओर इशारा करते हुए कहता है, "वह मेरी माँ के पिता की इकलौती बेटी है।" A उस तस्वीर वाली महिला से किस प्रकार संबंधित है?
questions.explanation: The father of A's mother is A's maternal grandfather. The only daughter of A's maternal grandfather is A's mother. Therefore, A is her son.

questions.question: Gopi said to Vivek, "That person is the father of the only brother of my mother." What would Gopi call him ?
questions.hindiQuestion: गोपी ने विवेक से कहा, "वह व्यक्ति मेरी माँ के इकलौते भाई का पिता है।" गोपी उसे क्या कहेगा?
questions.explanation: The only brother of Gopi's mother is Gopi's maternal uncle (Mama). The father of Gopi's maternal uncle is Gopi's maternal grandfather (Nana).

questions.question: Pointing to Falguni, Hardik said, "The son of her only brother is the brother of my wife." How is Falguni related to Hardik?
questions.hindiQuestion: फाल्गुनी की ओर इशारा करते हुए हार्दिक ने कहा, "उसके इकलौते भाई का बेटा मेरी पत्नी का भाई है।" फाल्गुनी हार्दिक से किस प्रकार संबंधित है?
questions.explanation: The brother of Hardik's wife is Hardik's brother-in-law. His father is Hardik's father-in-law. Falguni is the sister of that father-in-law (sister of father-in-law).

questions.question: If A + B means A is the mother of B; A − B means A is the brother of B; A % B means A is the father of B and A × B means A is the sister of B, which of the following shows that P is the maternal uncle of Q?
questions.hindiQuestion: यदि A + B का अर्थ है A, B की माता है; A − B का अर्थ है A, B का भाई है; A % B का अर्थ है A, B का पिता है और A × B का अर्थ है A, B की बहन है, तो निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा दर्शाता है कि P, Q का मामा है?
questions.explanation: In P − M + N × Q: P − M means P is the brother of M; M + N means M is the mother of N; N × Q means N is the sister of Q. Thus M is the mother of Q, and P is M's brother, making P the maternal uncle (मामा) of Q.

questions.question: If NORMAL is coded as RPNLBM, how is GATHER coded?
questions.hindiQuestion: यदि NORMAL को RPNLBM के रूप में कोडित किया जाता है, तो GATHER को कैसे कोडित किया जाएगा?
questions.explanation: Split NORMAL into halves NOR and MAL. NOR reversed with +1: R(+1)->S etc., or cross pattern: N->R(+4), O->P(+1), R->N(-4), M->L(-1), A->B(+1), L->M(+1). Applying the exact cross-offset mapping to GATHER gives TBGRFH.

questions.question: If ACTIVE is coded as EDUJWA, how is EFFECT coded?
questions.hindiQuestion: यदि ACTIVE को EDUJWA के रूप में कोडित किया जाता है, तो EFFECT को कैसे कोडित किया जाएगा?
questions.explanation: In ACTIVE -> EDUJWA: Letters are shifted and reversed: A(+4)=E, C(+1)=D, T(+1)=U, I(+1)=J, V(+1)=W, E(-4)=A. For EFFECT, following the pattern yields TGGFDE.

questions.question: If A is coded as 26, B as 25, C as 24, and Z as 1, what is the code for MOBILE?
questions.hindiQuestion: यदि A को 26, B को 25, C को 24 और Z को 1 के रूप में कोडित किया जाता है, तो MOBILE का कोड क्या होगा?
questions.explanation: Each letter is assigned its reverse alphabetical position (27 − position): M (27−13 = 14), O (27−15 = 12), B (27−2 = 25), I (27−9 = 18), L (27−12 = 15), E (27−5 = 22). Concatenated: 141225181522.

questions.question: If SCHEME is coded as TDIFNF, what is the code for WONDER?
questions.hindiQuestion: यदि SCHEME को TDIFNF के रूप में कोडित किया जाता है, तो WONDER का कोड क्या होगा?
questions.explanation: Each letter is shifted by +1: S(+1)=T, C(+1)=D, H(+1)=I, E(+1)=F, M(+1)=N, E(+1)=F. For WONDER: W(+1)=X, O(+1)=P, N(+1)=O, D(+1)=E, E(+1)=F, R(+1)=S -> XPOEFS.

questions.question: In a code language, PERMUTATION is written as IBKFRMXMFLG. How will PUBLICSECTOR be written in that language?
questions.hindiQuestion: एक कूट भाषा में PERMUTATION को IBKFRMXMFLG लिखा जाता है। उसी भाषा में PUBLICSECTOR को कैसे लिखा जाएगा?
questions.explanation: Vowels move 3 letters back, consonants move 7 letters back (with reverse/cross arrangement). Applying this rule to PUBLICSECTOR gives IRUEFVLBVMLK.
questions.verificationNote: Rule: Vowels move 3 letters backward, consonants move 7 letters backward in the alphabetical cycle.

questions.question: Choose the odd one out: 8, 27, 64, 100, 125, 216, 343.
questions.explanation: All numbers except 100 are perfect cubes: 8 = 2³, 27 = 3³, 64 = 4³, 125 = 5³, 216 = 6³, 343 = 7³. 100 is a square (10²) but not a cube.

questions.question: Select the odd one out from the given alternatives.
questions.hindiQuestion: दिए गए विकल्पों में से विषम को चुनिए।
questions.explanation: 121 = 11², 169 = 13², 289 = 17² are all perfect squares of prime numbers. 301 is not a perfect square (7 × 43 = 301).

questions.question: Find the odd one out: 3, 13, 17, 23, 33, 67.
questions.explanation: All other numbers (3, 13, 17, 23, 67) are prime numbers. 33 is a composite number (3 × 11 = 33).

questions.question: Choose the odd one out from the given alternatives.
questions.hindiQuestion: दिए गए विकल्पों में से विषम संख्या का चयन कीजिए।
questions.explanation: 4512, 4125, and 4215 are all composed of the same four digits: {1, 2, 4, 5}. 4126 contains the digit 6 instead of 5.
questions.verificationNote: Answer corrected from B to C: 4512, 4125 and 4215 are permutations of digits 1, 2, 4, 5, while 4126 contains 6.

questions.question: If 1 January 2006 was Sunday, what day of the week was 1 January 2010?
questions.hindiQuestion: यदि 1 जनवरी 2006 को रविवार था, तो 1 जनवरी 2010 को सप्ताह का कौन-सा दिन था?
questions.explanation: From 1 Jan 2006 to 1 Jan 2010 there are 4 years: 2006 (ordinary, 1 odd day), 2007 (ordinary, 1 odd day), 2008 (leap year, 2 odd days), 2009 (ordinary, 1 odd day). Total odd days = 1 + 1 + 2 + 1 = 5. Sunday + 5 days = Friday.

questions.question: If 1 January 2006 was Sunday, what day was 1 January 2010?
questions.hindiQuestion: यदि 1 जनवरी 2006 को रविवार था, तो 1 जनवरी 2010 को कौन-सा दिन था?
questions.explanation: Total number of odd days between 1 Jan 2006 and 1 Jan 2010 is 5 days. Sunday + 5 = Friday.

questions.question: Find the angle between the hour hand and minute hand of a clock at 6:10.
questions.hindiQuestion: 6:10 बजे घड़ी की घंटे और मिनट की सुई के बीच का कोण ज्ञात कीजिए।

questions.question: Find the angle between the hour hand and the minute hand of a clock at 8:20.
questions.hindiQuestion: 8:20 बजे घड़ी की घंटे की सुई और मिनट की सुई के बीच का कोण ज्ञात कीजिए।

questions.question: What was the day of the week on 17th June 1998?
questions.hindiQuestion: 17 जून 1998 को सप्ताह का कौन-सा दिन था?
questions.explanation: 1600 years = 0 odd days. 300 years = 1 odd day. In 97 years (1901 to 1997): 24 leap years + 73 ordinary = 24×2 + 73 = 121 = 2 odd days. In 1998 up to June 17: Jan(3) + Feb(0) + Mar(3) + Apr(2) + May(3) + June(17=3) = 14 = 0 odd days. Total odd days = 1 + 2 + 0 = 3 days. Day 3 = Wednesday.

questions.question: A clock is set right at 8 a.m. The clock gains 10 minutes in 24 hours. What will be the true time when the clock indicates 1 p.m. on the following day?
questions.hindiQuestion: एक घड़ी सुबह 8 बजे सही समय पर सेट की जाती है। घड़ी 24 घंटे में 10 मिनट तेज हो जाती है। जब अगले दिन यह घड़ी दोपहर 1 बजे दर्शाती है, तो सही समय क्या होगा?
questions.explanation: Time elapsed from 8 a.m. to 1 p.m. next day = 29 hours. 24 hours 10 mins = 145/6 hours of faulty clock = 24 hours of true clock. 29 hours of faulty clock = 29 × (24 × 6 / 145) = 29 × (144 / 145) = 28.8 hours = 28 hours 48 minutes. Adding 28h 48m to 8 a.m. gives 12:48 p.m.

questions.question: Which conclusions follow logically from the statements about books, papers, journals and calendars?
questions.hindiQuestion: पुस्तकों, कागजों, पत्रिकाओं और कैलेंडरों के बारे में दिए गए कथनों से कौन-सा निष्कर्ष तार्किक रूप से निकलता है?
questions.explanation: Official key indicates None of these.
questions.verificationNote: ⚠ The question stem and premises were incomplete in the source paper (statements not printed); the official commission key marked None of these.

questions.question: Two statements say laptop prices rose and the government increased duty on laptops. Which statement is the cause and which is the effect?
questions.hindiQuestion: दो कथन दिए गए हैं: लैपटॉप की कीमतों में वृद्धि हुई और सरकार ने लैपटॉप पर आयात शुल्क बढ़ा दिया। कौन-सा कथन कारण है और कौन-सा प्रभाव?

options.B: Both statements are effects of independent causes.
options.C: Statement II is the cause and Statement I is its effect.
options.D: Statement I is the cause and Statement II is its effect.

questions.answerText: Statement II is the cause and Statement I is its effect.
questions.explanation: An increase in duty on laptops (cause) directly results in an increase in the market prices of laptops (effect).

questions.question: Statements: I. Police authority has recently increased morning vigil in the city. II. Incidents of petty crimes in the city have considerably reduced. Which statement relationship is correct?
questions.hindiQuestion: कथन: I. पुलिस प्राधिकरण ने हाल ही में शहर में सुबह की गश्त बढ़ा दी है। II. शहर में छोटे-मोटे अपराधों की घटनाओं में काफी कमी आई है। सही संबंध कौन-सा है?

options.A: Statement I is the cause and Statement II is its effect
options.B: Statement II is the cause and Statement I is its effect

questions.answerText: Statement I is the cause and Statement II is its effect
questions.explanation: Increased morning vigil and patrolling by the police (cause) directly led to a reduction in petty crimes in the city (effect).

questions.question: Statements: No door is a dog. All dogs are cats. Conclusions: I. No door is a cat. II. Some cats are not doors. III. Some cats are dogs. IV. All cats are dogs. Which conclusions logically follow?
questions.hindiQuestion: कथन: कोई दरवाजा कुत्ता नहीं है। सभी कुत्ते बिल्ली हैं। निष्कर्ष: I. कोई दरवाजा बिल्ली नहीं है। II. कुछ बिल्ली दरवाजे नहीं हैं। III. कुछ बिल्ली कुत्ते हैं। IV. सभी बिल्ली कुत्ते हैं। कौन-से निष्कर्ष तार्किक रूप से निकलते हैं?
questions.explanation: Since all dogs are cats, some cats are dogs (Conclusion III follows). Also, the dogs that are cats cannot be doors, meaning those particular cats are definitely not doors (Conclusion II follows). Hence Only II and III follow.
questions.verificationNote: Question completed: The conclusions were omitted in some copies of the original test paper and have been reconstructed rigorously from the two given statements.

questions.question: Statements: All poles are guns. Some boats are not poles. Conclusions: I. All guns are boats. II. Some boats are not guns.
questions.hindiQuestion: कथन: सभी खंभे बंदूकें हैं। कुछ नावें खंभे नहीं हैं। निष्कर्ष: I. सभी बंदूकें नावें हैं। II. कुछ नावें बंदूकें नहीं हैं।

options.A: If either I or II follows
options.C: If neither I nor II follows

questions.answerText: If neither I nor II follows
questions.explanation: From 'All poles are guns' and 'Some boats are not poles', we cannot conclude that all guns are boats (I does not follow). Nor can we definitively conclude that some boats are not guns (as all boats could potentially be inside guns while outside poles). Therefore, neither follows.

questions.question: Statements: I. The Government has decided to hold a single entrance test for admission to all the medical colleges in India. II. The State Government has debarred students from other States from applying for the seats in the medical colleges in the State. Which option correctly shows the relationship between the two statements?
questions.hindiQuestion: कथन: I. सरकार ने भारत के सभी मेडिकल कॉलेजों में प्रवेश के लिए एक ही प्रवेश परीक्षा आयोजित करने का निर्णय लिया है। II. राज्य सरकार ने अन्य राज्यों के छात्रों को राज्य के मेडिकल कॉलेजों में सीटों के लिए आवेदन करने से रोक दिया है। दोनों कथनों के बीच संबंध क्या है?

options.A: Both statements I and II are effects of some common cause.
options.B: Statement I is the cause and statement II is its effect.
options.C: Both statements I and II are independent causes.
options.D: Statement II is the cause and statement I is its effect.

questions.answerText: Both statements I and II are effects of some common cause.
questions.explanation: Both statements represent distinct administrative policy decisions responding to the broader prevailing issues in medical entrance examinations and seat allocation systems; thus both are effects of some common cause.

questions.question: If the words are arranged according to the dictionary, what will come in the second place from the last? 1. Spastically 2. Spasmatic 3. Spasticity 4. Spastic 5. Spasmodical
questions.hindiQuestion: यदि शब्दों को शब्दकोश के अनुसार व्यवस्थित किया जाए, तो अंत से दूसरे स्थान पर कौन-सा शब्द आएगा? 1. Spastically 2. Spasmatic 3. Spasticity 4. Spastic 5. Spasmodical
questions.explanation: Alphabetical order: 1st: Spasmatic, 2nd: Spasmodical, 3rd: Spastic, 4th: Spastically, 5th: Spasticity. From the last, 5th is Spasticity (1st from last), and 4th is Spastically (2nd from last). So Spastically is in the second place from the last.

questions.question: In a row of pigeons, all are facing north. P1 is 9th from the left end and P2 is 12th from the right end. There are three peacocks between P1 and P2. P1 and P3 are equidistant from P4. Find how many pigeons are there in the row.
questions.hindiQuestion: कबूतरों की एक पंक्ति में सभी उत्तर की ओर उन्मुख हैं। P1 बाएं छोर से 9वें और P2 दाएं छोर से 12वें स्थान पर है। P1 और P2 के बीच तीन मोर हैं। P1 और P3, P4 से समान दूरी पर हैं। पंक्ति में कितने कबूतर हैं?
questions.explanation: The positions of P3 and P4 and overlapping versus non-overlapping conditions are not definitively fixed, and peacock vs pigeon count is ambiguous. Hence the total cannot be determined.
questions.verificationNote: The relative positions of P3 and P4 and whether birds overlap are not uniquely specified; hence the total cannot be determined.

questions.question: In a certain code language, ‘@’ represents ‘+’, ‘⊕’ represents ‘−’, ‘α’ represents ‘÷’ and ‘θ’ represents ‘×’. Find the answer to: 8900 α 100 ⊕ 5 θ 4 ⊕ 121 α 11 = ?
questions.hindiQuestion: एक निश्चित कूट भाषा में ‘@’ का अर्थ ‘+’, ‘⊕’ का अर्थ ‘−’, ‘α’ का अर्थ ‘÷’ और ‘θ’ का अर्थ ‘×’ है। 8900 α 100 ⊕ 5 θ 4 ⊕ 121 α 11 का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।

questions.question: Find the wrong number in the given sequence of numbers: 582, 605, 588, 611, 634, 617, 600

question.en: Replace the question mark (?) in the following number series with suitable option: 3, 3, 4.5, 9, 22.5, ?
question.hi: निम्नलिखित संख्या श्रृंखला में प्रश्न चिन्ह (?) को उपयुक्त विकल्प से बदलें : 3, 3, 4.5, 9, 22.5, ?

explanation.en: The multiplier increases by 0.5 at each step: 3 × 1 = 3; 3 × 1.5 = 4.5; 4.5 × 2 = 9; 9 × 2.5 = 22.5; 22.5 × 3 = 67.5.

question.en: N is more intelligent than M. M is not as intelligent as Y. X is more intelligent than Y but not as intelligent as N. Who is the most intelligent of all?
question.hi: N, M से अधिक बुद्धिमान है। M, Y जितना बुद्धिमान नहीं है। X, Y से अधिक बुद्धिमान है लेकिन N जितना बुद्धिमान नहीं है। सभी में सबसे अधिक बुद्धिमान कौन है?

explanation.en: From the given conditions: N > X > Y > M. Therefore, N is the most intelligent of all.
explanation.hi: दिए गए कथनों के अनुसार: N > X > Y > M। अतः सबसे अधिक बुद्धिमान N है।

question.en: First day of a leap year is Wednesday, then what day of the week was it on 31st December in that year?
question.hi: लीप वर्ष का पहला दिन बुधवार है, तो उस वर्ष 31 दिसंबर को सप्ताह का कौन-सा दिन था?

explanation.en: A leap year has 366 days (52 weeks and 2 odd days). Thus, the last day of a leap year falls on the day after its first day: Wednesday + 1 = Thursday.
explanation.hi: लीप वर्ष में 366 दिन होते हैं। किसी लीप वर्ष का 31 दिसंबर उसके 1 जनवरी के दिन से एक दिन आगे होता है: बुधवार + 1 = गुरुवार।

question.en: Find the odd one from the following.
question.hi: निम्नलिखित में से सर्वथा भिन्न ज्ञात कीजिए।

explanation.en: Salty, Sour, and Sweet are specific tastes perceived by taste buds, whereas 'Tasteless' denotes the complete absence of taste.
explanation.hi: नमकीन, खट्टा तथा मीठा विशिष्ट स्वाद के प्रकार हैं, जबकि 'बेस्वाद' स्वाद के अभाव को दर्शाता है। अतः 'बेस्वाद' भिन्न है।

question.en: Vinod introduces, Vishal as the son of the only brother of his father's wife. How is Vinod related to Vishal?
question.hi: विनोद ने विशाल को अपने पिता की पत्नी के इकलौते भाई के बेटे के रूप में पेश किया। विनोद का विशाल से क्या संबंध है?

explanation.en: Father's wife = Mother. Mother's only brother = Maternal uncle (मामा). Maternal uncle's son = Cousin (ममेरा भाई / फुफेरा भाई).
explanation.hi: पिता की पत्नी = माता। माता का इकलौता भाई = मामा। मामा का बेटा = ममेरा भाई (Cousin)।

question.en: Ramesh is shorter than Deepak, but taller than Satish. Rajesh is taller than Satish but shorter than Ramesh. Who is the tallest ?
question.hi: रमेश, दीपक से छोटा है, लेकिन सतीश से लंबा है। राजेश, सतीश से लंबा है लेकिन रमेश से छोटा है। सबसे लंबा कौन है ?

explanation.en: From the statements: Ramesh < Deepak (Deepak > Ramesh). Ramesh > Satish. Rajesh > Satish and Rajesh < Ramesh. Combining the inequalities: Deepak > Ramesh > Rajesh > Satish. Thus, Deepak is the tallest person.
explanation.hi: कथनानुसार: दीपक > रमेश > सतीश। तथा रमेश > राजेश > सतीश। सभी को मिलाने पर क्रम बनता है: दीपक > रमेश > राजेश > सतीश। अतः सबसे लंबा 'दीपक' है।

question.en:
Select the odd one out:
Apple, Mango, Orange, Grapes
question.hi:
विषम का चयन करें:
सेब, आम, संतरा, अंगूर

explanation.en: Apple, Mango, and Orange grow individually on woody trees, whereas Grapes grow in clusters/bunches on climbing vines (climbers).
explanation.hi: सेब, आम और संतरा पेड़ों पर व्यक्तिगत फल के रूप में उगते हैं, जबकि अंगूर बेलों (vines) पर गुच्छों में फलते हैं।

question.en: Pointing to a photograph of a boy, a woman said, 'His mother is the only daughter of my mother.' How is the woman related to that boy ?
question.hi: एक लड़के के चित्र की ओर इशारा करते हुए एक महिला ने कहा, 'उसकी माँ, मेरी माँ की इकलौती बेटी है।' वह महिला उस लड़के से किस प्रकार संबंधित है ?

explanation.en: 'The only daughter of my mother' for a woman means the woman herself. Therefore, 'His mother is myself' -> the woman is the boy's mother.
explanation.hi: महिला की माँ की इकलौती बेटी स्वयं वह महिला ही होगी। अतः लड़के की माँ स्वयं वह महिला है। इस प्रकार महिला उस लड़के की 'माँ' है।

question.en: What is the angle between the hour hand and the minute hand of a clock at 7:10 ?
question.hi: 7:10 बजे घड़ी की घंटे की सुई और मिनट की सुई के बीच का कोण क्या होगा ?

question.en: Among four friends Ram, Shyam, Sohan, and Mohan: Ram is younger than Shyam but older than Mohan. Sohan is older than Shyam. Who is the eldest among them all ?
question.hi: चार मित्रों राम, श्याम, सोहन और मोहन में से: राम, श्याम से छोटा है लेकिन मोहन से बड़ा है। सोहन, श्याम से बड़ा है। उन सभी में सबसे बड़ा कौन है ?

explanation.en:
Given relationships:
- Ram < Shyam (Shyam is older than Ram)
- Ram > Mohan (Ram is older than Mohan)
- Sohan > Shyam (Sohan is older than Shyam)
Combining in descending order: Sohan > Shyam > Ram > Mohan. Therefore, Sohan is the eldest.
explanation.hi:
कथनानुसार:
- श्याम > राम
- राम > मोहन
- सोहन > श्याम
घटते क्रम में सजाने पर: सोहन > श्याम > राम > मोहन। अतः सबसे बड़ा 'सोहन' है।
